description: Fetches Clash Royale card statistics from noff.gg including hitpoints, damage, speed, range, win rate, pick rate, and other stats for both single-entity and multi-entity cards.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_card: 获取指定卡牌的详细数据; 需要 card_name 参数; 参数: card_name; 必填: card_name

card_name.description: 卡牌名称(URL格式)。例如: mega-knight, rascals, pekka, goblin-barrel,  skeleton-army。空格会自动转换为连字符。由 get_card 函数使用。
